versions.name: Custaloga Town Scout Reservation

features.note: Guyasuta Braves, for Scouts in their first year.
CTSRTREK: kayaking, hiking, biking, and horseback riding from a state-park base, returning to camp for the ATV program.
The Gradin Nature Lodge, holding tanks, taxidermy, and hands-on exhibits.
Scoutcraft campers hike to the outer limits of the property and camp there.
A Sci-Tech centre covering engineering through space exploration.
Swimming and lifesaving instruction, plus a learn-to-swim programme.
A boat house on the water, run alongside the pool as one aquatics area.

versions.summary: French Creek Council's resident summer camp in Carlton, Pennsylvania, serving Scouts BSA and Cub Scouts.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The council's Scouts BSA summer camp page, which covers this reservation, was read as the second source for program detail.
